_README: Verified research, August 2026. EVERY entry here was confirmed against an official source (city .gov parks pages, NCES/CCD federal school records, Census Reporter ACS 2024). Anything that could not be confirmed is marked UNVERIFIED and MUST NOT be published as fact. School ATTENDANCE BOUNDARIES were deliberately not researched -- they live only in the interactive BCPS locator -- so never write 'zoned for X'. Use 'serves the area' language instead.
_do_not_publish: Cypress Park, Coral Springs -- basketball courts were removed/converted to pickleball. Aggregators still list them. DO NOT list as a venue.
Sabal Pines Park, Coconut Creek -- the city's own amenity page does NOT list basketball. DO NOT list.
Caporella Park, Tamarac -- city lists a 'multi-purpose court', not basketball. DO NOT claim hoops.
North Lauderdale -- NO basketball court confirmed at any of its 18 parks. NO page until a human calls 954-724-7061.
Any school attendance boundary or 'zoned for' claim, all cities.

cities._feeder_note: VERIFIED from the official BCPS 2025-26 Feeder Pattern from Middle to High School report (observed student counts, not inference): Forest Glen 100% to Coral Springs High; Sawgrass Springs 100% to Coral Glades; Ramblewood 100% to Taravella; Coral Springs Middle 50.5% Coral Glades / 49.5% Stoneman Douglas. This is a genuinely local, checkable detail and it is safe to publish -- unlike ADDRESS-LEVEL zoning, which remains unverified. Feeder pattern = where students actually go. Attendance boundary = which address is assigned where. Say the former, never the latter.

cities._caution: CORRECTED Aug 2026 from a second verification pass. (1) NO city park page states a basketball court count anywhere in Coral Springs. The earlier 'two courts' at Betti Stradling and 'four courts' at Sportsplex were unsourced -- NEVER state a court number for this city. (2) Cypress PARK (1301 Coral Springs Dr) has NO basketball; Cypress HAMMOCK (1300 Coral Springs Dr) does. Nearly identical addresses, different parks -- do not confuse them. (3) Sportsplex is deliberately omitted as a session venue: its courts are closed until 6pm on school days, which is exactly when a trainer would use them. (4) Riverside Park omitted -- courts close at 9pm. Castlewood omitted -- sunset only, no lights. (5) Coral Springs Gymnasium is omitted: the city has NO working web page for it, all four plausible URLs 404, and its address is third-party only. It is real and hosts Basketball Club games, but nothing about it is city-verifiable. (6) Courts ARE reservable here, unlike Coconut Creek -- permit required, 3 days ahead, $15 single-use or $25 multi-use, call 954-345-2200. (7) Median income corrected to $93,602 (ACS 2020-2024) from $98,926, and population to the 2025 estimate of 138,783. (8) Heron Bay, Wyndham Lakes, Whispering Woods and Cypress Glen could NOT be confirmed as named areas from any city source -- do not name them even though they appear on the client's map. Turtle Run, Ramblewood and Forest Hills ARE confirmed. (9) Strong verified positioning fact: there is NO YMCA and NO Boys & Girls Club anywhere in Coral Springs, Parkland, Margate, Coconut Creek or Tamarac.

cities._caution: CORRECTED Aug 2026 from a second verification pass. (1) George S. Gerber Memorial Park is REMOVED -- its basketball court is CLOSED for resurfacing with no reopening date. Do not list it. (2) The city's indoor gym at the Recreation Complex, 4455 Sol Press Blvd 33073, is real but gated behind a CreekFit 'Fitness+' membership -- resident Fitness-only at $50/yr explicitly EXCLUDES the gym, non-resident is $250/yr, and gym access is unavailable during camp programming. Do not imply open indoor access. (3) The city publishes NO way to rent a basketball court -- only fields, volleyball and pavilions. Outdoor drop-in at Windmill and Winston is the realistic option. (4) No court counts are published anywhere in the city; never state one. (5) 'Butterfly Capital of the World' IS confirmed on the city's own About page and is safe to use. The MainStreet district is defined by the city as bounded by Wiles Rd north, Lyons Rd east, Sample Rd south, SR 7 west. (6) coconutcreek.net now 301s to coconutcreek.gov. (7) Wyndham Lakes, Centura Parc and Cocobay have NO official-source confirmation -- do not name them even though Wyndham Lakes appears on the client's map.

Tamarac has a large retirement population; households-with-children share is VERIFIED at 22.0% (ACS 2024 5-year, table B11005) -- the lowest of the five cities, and it matters commercially here more than anywhere else.

excluded.reason: The city's park directory lists 18 parks by name and street address with NO amenities. Parks and Rec confirms the city runs basketball leagues but never says where. Not one court is confirmed. Publishing a venue here would be a guess. Unblock with one call to 954-724-7061, then it can have a page.
